tagline.en: Splatt3R — feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from a pair of uncalibrated images, no poses or camera intrinsics required.
tagline.zh: Splatt3R——从一对未标定图像前馈生成 3D 高斯泼溅，无需相机位姿或内参。

en: Splatt3R is a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model from Brandon Smart and collaborators. Given two ordinary photos of a scene, it predicts a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation in a single pass — no per-scene optimization, and no camera poses or calibration needed.

It builds on the DUSt3R/MASt3R line of pointmap-based geometry models, extending them to directly output splats you can render from new viewpoints. In WorldFoundry the runtime produces a PLY Gaussian splat file as its artifact, ready to load into standard splat viewers.
Because it is feed-forward, reconstruction is fast compared with optimization-based Gaussian Splatting: you supply the image pair and get a 3D scene out.
zh: Splatt3R 是 Brandon Smart 及合作者的前馈式 3D 重建模型。给它同一场景的两张普通照片，它便一次前向推理即可预测出 3D 高斯泼溅表示——无需逐场景优化，也不需要相机位姿或标定。
它承袭 DUSt3R/MASt3R 这一基于 pointmap 的几何模型路线，并将其扩展为可直接输出用于新视角渲染的高斯泼溅。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时会产出一个 PLY 高斯泼溅文件，可直接载入常见的 splat 查看器。
由于是前馈式，其重建速度相比基于优化的高斯泼溅要快得多：给它一对图像，就能得到一个 3D 场景。

whenToUse.en: Great when you want fast 3D reconstruction from just two casual photos, with no camera calibration and no lengthy per-scene optimization.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望仅凭两张随手拍的照片快速做 3D 重建，且不想做相机标定或漫长的逐场景优化时，它非常合适。

notFor.en: Aimed at sparse two-view reconstruction rather than dense many-view capture; checkpoints are external assets you stage separately.
notFor.zh: 面向稀疏双视图重建，而非稠密多视图采集；checkpoint 是外部资源，需单独准备。

en: Reconstructs 3D from a pair of uncalibrated images
Outputs a PLY Gaussian splat artifact
Built on the DUSt3R / MASt3R geometry lineage
zh: 从一对未标定图像重建 3D
前馈式——无需逐场景优化
